about.description: Est. in 2022, The Curry Modern Indian Restaurant brings fresh, bold, and modern Indian Cuisine to Huntsville, Alabama. Our chefs are masters at Indian Cuisine, providing guests with the highest quality curries, biryanis, dosas, and more.
about.elevator_pitch: Modern Indian restaurant in Huntsville offering authentic regional cuisine with top culinary techniques and picturesque ambiance.
about.vibe: Contemporary Indian dining with authentic flavors, picture-perfect presentation, and friendly service in a beautifully designed space.
about.insider_tip: Offers weekend lunch buffet with authentic Indian street food including pani puri and chai. 100% halal certified. Tons of parking available.
